glosses: To run a process that collects fragments of files and sorts them into contiguous sections on one or more hard disks or hard disk partitions, thus speeding up file management.

examples.text: SSDs don't need defragmenting. Windows wont' even let you try to defragment an SSD. However, if you could defragment an SSD, you might shorten the device's lifespan.

glosses: Redistribuir los fragmentos de los archivos en un disco rígido para que estos queden en posiciones contiguas y así aumentar la eficiencia.
